title: NeuroMetBench 2.0.2 scientific reproducibility release
description: Scientific reproducibility release for the NeuroMetBench Original Article. Frozen biological endpoints, cohorts, thresholds, statistical results, and adverse results are unchanged from v2.0.0. Version 2.0.2 repairs current method-result-claim traceability, cohort accounting, scenario-level simulation exposure, comparator execution provenance, data-access boundaries, figure semantics, accessibility-field text, and release metadata. The reusable neurometbench-ref software component remains version 1.0.1.
